usedFor: A new Trello board gets a matching list in ClickUp.

bestTemplate.name: “New/Updated Board” in Trello, then “Create List” in ClickUp
bestTemplate.why: It gives every new Trello board a ClickUp list, so nobody rebuilds structure by hand.

watchOut: “New/Updated Board” fires on updates too, so one Trello board can create a duplicate ClickUp list.
